command:
set -euo pipefail
interfaces=(IIOBackend IRenderer IBindlessHeap ICommandContext IDevice IProfiler ITransferQueue IWindow ICameraController IRuntimeModule)
surfaces=(AssetRegistry AssetService CallbackRegistry EngineConfigSectionRegistry LockFreeQueue PropertyRegistry FrameRecipePassContributionRegistry GpuBufferUploadSubmission RenderSubsystemRegistry PlacedResourceBinding VulkanTransferQueue CameraControllerRegistry EditorWindowRegistry VertexAttributeBinding VertexChannelSourceBinding RuntimeInputActionBinding RuntimeInputActionRegistry JobService ServiceRegistry WorldRegistry ClusteringService PointCloudConsolidationService TextureBakeService RenderArtifactRegistry StableEntityLookupSceneBinding)
printf 'kind\tname\tproduction_implementations\tnon_definition_source_files\ttest_reference_files\n'
for name in "${interfaces[@]}"; do
  impls=$(rg -n "public[[:space:]]+([A-Za-z0-9_:]+::)?${name}\\b" src -g '*.cpp' -g '*.cppm' -g '*.hpp' | wc -l)
  mapfile -t defs < <(rg -l "\\b(class|struct)[[:space:]]+${name}\\b" src -g '*.cppm')
  external=0
  while read -r ref; do
    skip=0
    for def in "${defs[@]}"; do
      stem="${def%.cppm}"
      if [ "$ref" = "$def" ] || [ "$ref" = "${stem}.cpp" ] || [ "$ref" = "${stem}.hpp" ]; then skip=1; fi
    done
    if [ "$skip" -eq 0 ]; then external=$((external + 1)); fi
  done < <(rg -l "\\b${name}\\b" src -g '*.cpp' -g '*.cppm' -g '*.hpp')
  test_refs=$(rg -l "\\b${name}\\b" tests -g '*.cpp' -g '*.cppm' -g '*.hpp' | wc -l)
  printf 'interface\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$impls" "$external" "$test_refs"
done
for name in "${surfaces[@]}"; do
  mapfile -t defs < <(rg -l "\\b(class|struct)[[:space:]]+${name}\\b" src -g '*.cppm')
  external=0
  while read -r ref; do
    skip=0
    for def in "${defs[@]}"; do
      stem="${def%.cppm}"
      if [ "$ref" = "$def" ] || [ "$ref" = "${stem}.cpp" ] || [ "$ref" = "${stem}.hpp" ]; then skip=1; fi
    done
    if [ "$skip" -eq 0 ]; then external=$((external + 1)); fi
  done < <(rg -l "\\b${name}\\b" src -g '*.cpp' -g '*.cppm' -g '*.hpp')
  test_refs=$(rg -l "\\b${name}\\b" tests -g '*.cpp' -g '*.cppm' -g '*.hpp' | wc -l)
  printf 'surface\t%s\t1\t%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$external" "$test_refs"
done
